note: EXAMPLE of the gap ledger. limitation_kind in shared_limitation / uncovered_scenario / conflicting_conclusions / evaluation_gap / method_gap / data_gap. evidence.kind in quote / paraphrase / author_judgment; every quote below occurs verbatim in that reference's abstract.

gaps.statement: Existing selection rules optimise the label budget or a fixed feature space, and none of them optimises the cost of pretraining the corpus itself.

evidence.text: ignores the cost of the pretraining corpus itself, which dominates the budget at scale
the number of forward passes grows linearly with pool size and dominates the compute budget
the coreset guarantee is stated for a fixed feature space and does not transfer to representations that are themselves learned

how_filled.mechanism: select before pretraining, in a fixed spectral embedding, so the corpus becomes an explicit budget

gaps.statement: Scaling evidence shows most of a large unlabelled pool is redundant, but no experiment tests whether a much smaller curated corpus reaches the same plateau.

evidence.text: the study cannot say whether a smaller curated corpus would reach the same plateau with less compute
no experiment studies whether a smaller corpus would suffice
agnostic to which unlabelled graphs are used, so redundant corpora waste compute without improving the objective

how_filled.mechanism: a budget sweep that locates where selection stops paying
